title: Sometimes Green Isn't Easy
text: Sometimes Green Isn't Easy. UGH I really wish that these would have worked perfectly. I was looking for a "green" solution to wasting tons of tiny plastic bags, but these aren't it. They are the WORST to clean. I put them in the dishwasher and afterwards they would still have tiny bits of food/grime even though they were propped straight up on prongs in my dishwasher. They also were pretty impossible to dry which was annoying too. Sure you could flip them inside out to dry,  but they didn't seem like they'd last long to that type of movement. Besides that they didn't always zip seal easily so I was worried about food coming out. So if you're looking for a green solution to baggies, this isn't it - probably would be better buying ziplocs and reducing how many you use rather than wasting all this plastic for these ones. I don't recommend at all.
